sections.title: BF Comic Series
sections.content:
Vektor makes only one appearance in the BF Comic Series. In the fifty-eighth episode of the comic series, Vektor is showcased along with Galene being outnumbered by surrounding enemies. Without much effort, Galene manages to take down the enemies while Vektor is left with serious injuries.

Vektor appears in the following episodes of the BF Comic Series:
- BF Comic 058: Did my best

==History==

==Non-Canon Appearances==
===[[BF Comic Series]]===
[[File:Vektor BFComicSeries.PNG|thumb|150px|Vektor in the BF Comic Series]]
Vektor makes only one appearance in the BF Comic Series. In the fifty-eighth episode of the comic series, Vektor is showcased along with [[Galene (character)|Galene]] being outnumbered by surrounding enemies. Without much effort, Galene manages to take down the enemies while Vektor is left with serious injuries.

Vektor appears in the following episodes of the BF Comic Series:
*[[BF Comic:058|BF Comic 058: Did my best]]
